DOOM RUNNER - a GZDoom mod by BockwurstWilly
============================================

Start: double-click "Doom Runner.bat". That's it.

The game runs right away with Freedoom (free Doom replacement, included).

  >>> STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: play with the ORIGINAL DOOM2.WAD AND BRUTAL DOOM! <<<

1. Original Doom II:
   Copy your DOOM2.WAD into this folder (next to "Doom Runner.bat").
   You find it in your Doom II install folder (Steam, GOG, ...),
   on Steam e.g. ...\steamapps\common\Doom 2\base\DOOM2.WAD
2. Brutal Doom:
   Download Brutal Doom (https://www.moddb.com/mods/brutal-doom) and copy its
   .pk3 file (name starts with "brutal", e.g. brutalv22.pk3) into this folder.
   It is loaded automatically.

Controls: mouse left/right = steer, click = buy upgrade / start.
Keyboard works too: A/D or arrow keys, 1/2/3, Space. ESC = menu.
Progress is saved automatically (DoomRunner.ini in this folder).
The game can be switched between English and German in the main menu.
